Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Self and up to three allies who can hear and understand you. Spend one minute forming a plan from the evidence and observations available. State the plan. The DA confirms what is true, what remains uncertain, and one contradiction or risk. You and each chosen ally gain 2 Boons to your next roll that directly follows the plan.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
One minute.
Target / range / shape
Self and up to three allies who can hear and understand you.
Duration
The plan and its stated limits remain known; each Boon expires when used or at the end of the scene.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene.
Type
Signature
